name: label-quality-audit
hypothesis: Audit all 12 targets for ontology coverage gaps before any model work
primary_change: Run rule labeler on synthetic corpus and measure per-target recall
expected_gain: Reduces label noise which is the highest-leverage fix
priority_rationale: Label quality gates everything downstream

name: 2.5d-cnn-efficientnet-b0
hypothesis: Small 2.5D EfficientNet-B0 baseline on 6 primary series slots
primary_change: Single backbone with slice-level pooling to study-level prediction
expected_gain: Baseline macro AUC reference point
priority_rationale: Cheap enough to iterate; establishes floor

name: multi-task-loss-weight-sweep
hypothesis: Sweep loss weights across 12 targets to handle class imbalance
primary_change: Weighted BCE with inverse-frequency weights per target
expected_gain: Improves rare-target AUC without architecture change
priority_rationale: One-factor change from E02 baseline

name: focal-loss
hypothesis: Focal loss instead of plain BCE for all targets
primary_change: Gamma=2 alpha=0.25 standard focal loss
expected_gain: May improve hard-example focus on imbalanced targets
priority_rationale: Direct swap of loss function only

name: slice-sampling-uniform-vs-topk
hypothesis: Compare uniform slice sampling vs top-k by attention score
primary_change: Uniform samples N slices vs top-k selection strategy
expected_gain: Tests whether informative slices are being captured
priority_rationale: Preprocessing-level change with no architecture cost

name: augmentation-strength
hypothesis: Test mild vs aggressive augmentation on synthetic and real smoke data
primary_change: Mild (flip+rot5) vs aggressive (elastic+noise+cutout)
expected_gain: Determines optimal augmentation budget for knee MRI
priority_rationale: Standard sweep before scaling up compute

name: series-slot-embedding
hypothesis: Add learnable series-slot embedding to distinguish MRI sequences
primary_change: Concatenate slot embedding to pooled features before final linear layer
expected_gain: Lets model differentiate T1/T2/PD-weighted inputs
priority_rationale: Architecture change targeting domain knowledge

name: efficientnet-b3-scale
hypothesis: Scale backbone from B0 to B3 with same preprocessing
primary_change: Backbone capacity increase only
expected_gain: Tests whether more parameters help or overfit
priority_rationale: Follows E02 once baseline is established

name: cross-validation-fold-strategy
hypothesis: Compare 5-fold grouped CV vs 8-fold for stability
primary_change: Same model different fold count
expected_gain: More folds reduce variance in OOF estimate at linear compute cost
priority_rationale: Evaluation methodology validation before leaderboard submissions

name: ensemble-weighted-average
hypothesis: Ensemble top-3 models by weighted average of OOF probabilities
primary_change: Grid search ensemble weights on OOF predictions
expected_gain: Typical +0.005-0.015 macro AUC gain
priority_rationale: No new training required if OOF files exist

name: ensemble-stacking
hypothesis: Stack top-3 models with logistic regression meta-learner
primary_change: OOF predictions as features for a simple meta-model
expected_gain: May capture complementarity that averaging misses
priority_rationale: More complex than E10 but still cheap

name: pseudo-label-threshold
hypothesis: Pseudo-label high-confidence test-set predictions back into training
primary_change: Threshold=0.95 positive pseudo-labels added to training fold
expected_gain: Self-training can improve recall on underrepresented classes
priority_rationale: Requires careful leakage audit; one factor at a time

name: tta-horizontal-flip
hypothesis: Test-time augmentation with left-right flip averaged into prediction
primary_change: Flip is anatomically reasonable for paired structures
expected_gain: Free improvement typically +0.002-0.005 macro AUC
priority_rationale: No training change; inference-only modification

name: preprocessing-window-rescale
hypothesis: Test lung-window-style intensity normalization vs min-max per study
primary_change: Normalization strategy affects what the model sees
expected_gain: DICOM rescale slope/intercept handling may vary across scanners
priority_rationale: Preprocessing correctness gate before any scale-up

name: attention-mil-for-slices
hypothesis: Attention-based multiple-instance learning over slice features
primary_change: Replaces mean pooling with learned attention weights
expected_gain: Model attends to diagnostically relevant slices automatically
priority_rationale: Architecture upgrade from E02 mean pooling

name: bilateral-context
hypothesis: Feed both knees as input channels to capture bilateral asymmetry
primary_change: Contralateral knee provides normal reference signal
expected_gain: Bilateral comparison is clinically relevant for OA and effusion grading
priority_rationale: Input format change requiring pipeline update

name: grad-cam-visual-qa
hypothesis: Generate Grad-CAM heatmaps for human visual QA of model attention
primary_change: Overlay attention on sample slices for reviewer inspection
expected_gain: Confirms model looks at anatomy not artifacts; supports human review gate
priority_rationale: Quality assurance not performance gain directly

name: label-smoothing
hypothesis: Label smoothing epsilon=0.1 for all targets
primary_change: Softens targets to prevent overconfident predictions
expected_gain: May improve calibration without changing ranking significantly
priority_rationale: Regularization-only change from E02

name: mixup-cutmix
hypothesis: Apply MixUp or CutMix between studies in the same fold
primary_change: Interpolated inputs and soft labels
expected_gain: Data-level regularization that may help small effective dataset size
priority_rationale: Augmentation-level change requiring loss adjustment

name: swa-stochastic-weight-averaging
hypothesis: Average model weights from last N epochs for better generalization
primary_change: SWA over final epoch checkpoints
expected_gain: Often improves OOF AUC by reducing sharp-minimum overfitting
priority_rationale: Training procedure change no extra data needed

name: per-series-models
hypothesis: Train separate specialist models for ligament/meniscus/OA target groups
primary_change: Three specialized models each seeing relevant series slots
expected_gain: Domain decomposition may outperform single multi-task model
priority_rationale: Architecture restructuring; higher compute cost

name: deeper-3d-cnn
hypothesis: True 3D convolution preserving spatial relationships between slices
primary_change: 3D kernels capture inter-slice context lost in 2.5D pooling
expected_gain: Anatomically motivated but computationally expensive
priority_rationale: Only if 2.5D ceiling is reached and GPU budget allows

name: vision-transformer
hypothesis: Vision Transformer on study-level aggregated features
primary_change: Treats pooled slice statistics as tokens for self-attention
expected_gain: Alternative architecture may capture long-range dependencies
priority_rationale: High-risk exploration; needs strong baseline first

name: external-pretrained-knee
hypothesis: Use publicly available knee-MRI pretrained weights if rules permit
primary_change: Transfer from public knee datasets (e.g. OAI)
expected_gain: Warm start may accelerate convergence on limited data
priority_rationale: Requires equal-access verification and license check first

name: threshold-optimization
hypothesis: Optimize per-class probability thresholds for submission metric
primary_change: Macro AUC is threshold-independent so this tests whether it matters
expected_gain: ROC AUC is rank-based so thresholds should not affect it directly
priority_rationale: Low priority unless metric definition changes

name: report-text-fusion
hypothesis: Fuse report-derived weak-label probabilities as auxiliary training signal
primary_change: Multi-modal input combining image features with text embeddings
expected_gain: Report text contains diagnostic information images may miss
priority_rationale: Highest-risk highest-reward; requires text model and privacy gate

name: curriculum-learning
hypothesis: Order training samples easy-to-hard based on weak-label confidence
primary_change: Start with confident labels then introduce uncertain ones
expected_gain: May improve convergence on noisy label landscape
priority_rationale: Training schedule change with no architecture cost

name: knowledge-distillation
hypothesis: Distill ensemble of top-3 models into single efficient model
primary_change: Teacher ensemble generates soft targets for student model
expected_gain: Single-model inference within time ceiling with near-ensemble accuracy
priority_rationale: Required if ensemble exceeds inference budget

name: test-domain-adaptation
hypothesis: Fine-tune batch-norm statistics on unlabeled test distribution
primary_change: Adapt normalization layers to target-domain image statistics
expected_gain: May improve generalization if train/test distributions differ
priority_rationale: Risky; requires careful monitoring to avoid degradation

name: full-pipeline-integration-test
hypothesis: End-to-end integration test from raw synthetic DICOM through submission CSV
primary_change: Validates every module boundary works together
expected_gain: Catches interface mismatches before real data is touched
priority_rationale: Engineering gate not an experiment but must pass before any Kaggle run
